## Security Considerations

Prompt injection is a known risk when AI agents process untrusted content. Researchers have documented techniques where attackers embed instructions in web pages.

### Mitigation Strategies

To defend against prompt injection, applications should validate all inputs and use structured outputs. The ignore-previous-instructions attack class is well-studied but not the only vector.
